description: Locate and delete a specific complaint case in ArkCase to maintain data hygiene. Log in as Administrator (arkcase-admin@dev.arkcase.com / ArkCase1234!). Find the case titled 'TEST-CASE-REMOVE-ME'. This case was created in error and must be permanently removed from the system. Ensure you do NOT delete any other cases, specifically 'IMPORTANT-active-case-001' which must remain. Navigate to the case details and perform the delete action.
